title: Demimondaine
html_source:
A demimondaine is a woman of the demimonde, living a hedonistic or extravagant lifestyle (i.e., pleasure-seeking as contrasted with aristocratic or noble behavior).

The term ‘demi-monde’ is French for “half-world”. It derives from a comedy called Le Demi-Monde, by Alexandre Dumas, fils, published in 1855.
